output_list.criticism: The mint function allows the preSale address to mint arbitrary amounts, which is a severe vulnerability. The preSale address can mint tokens, granting it excessive control. The vulnerability is not profitable.
The transfer function allows the attacker to cause an integer overflow, freezing funds in user accounts. The vulnerability is not profitable.
The transferFrom function allows the attacker to cause an integer overflow, granting arbitrary token transfers. The vulnerability is not profitable.
The approve function allows the attacker to cause an integer overflow, granting excessive allowance. The vulnerability is not profitable.
The increaseApproval function allows the attacker to cause an integer overflow, granting excessive allowance. The vulnerability is not profitable.
The decreaseApproval function allows the attacker to cause an integer overflow, reducing allowance to a negative value. The vulnerability is not profitable.
